title: Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #16 (부채꼴·매끈 | 크리스탈+드래곤비늘+인어비늘+왁스)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, blunt collarbone-length bob thick heavy — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 53% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 4 o'clock, 7 o'clock, 11 o'clock and 1 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 7 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries ruby crystal clusters growing directly out of her own skin, erupting in true three-dimensional relief, each facet casting its own hard shadow, BLAZING RUBY RED crystal points, VIVID GOLD mineral veins. Region 2 is the wedge between the 7 o'clock ray and the 11 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID DEEP EMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the wedge between the 11 o'clock ray and the 1 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC CYAN scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the wedge between the 1 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries molten wax flowing and set directly over her own skin, BLAZING DEEP CRIMSON wax streams pooling and hardening, VIVID AMBER translucent drip-ridges catching the light. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it., no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
